summary: Admin Control now stops itself before a deploy swaps its folder, so a running instance no longer fails the build and blocks every other component in the same run.
details: Adds the apps.admin.kill_all switch that Bridge, Engine, Gateway and Orchestrator already have; Admin Control polls it in its heartbeat thread and shuts down through its normal path.
Nothing supervises Admin Control, so its build clears the switch and relaunches the server headless; an open Admin Control page needs a refresh after a deploy.
Rollback stops Admin Control through the same window it deploys with.
The Launcher keeps its in-place fallback instead: the process pinning its folder is another app, so there is nothing it could stop.
